clock_basis: Profile clock is America/Cancun, UTC-5, no DST, checked against tzdata 2026e. America/Vancouver moves PDT to MST at 2026-11-01 09:00 UTC and stays UTC-7, so Vancouver wall time is Cancun plus 2h on both sides of that instant. Every-hour minute crons are unchanged. 40 */3 * * * Vancouver becomes 40 2-23/3 * * * Cancun. America/Denver still switches MDT UTC-6 and MST UTC-7, so 20 */2 * * * matches Denver standard time and is one hour later during MDT. The 30-minute usage job is an interval and has no civil-time conversion. The BLOCKED listener is not a cron.
